opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, then note
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotel, Viator activity, then save a summary trip note.
steps: Google Flights: set destination (origin Paris), pick departure and return dates, search, note cheapest flight
Booking.com: enter destination, select dates, search, open a hotel and note name/price
Viator: search for the top attraction tour in the destination, open the first result, note title/price
Open notes app, create new note with 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., activity...' and press Enter
